name: CoverAI
headline: A generative AI product that has written 100K+ tailored cover letters
overview: CoverAI is a cover letter generation platform built end to end by Techlio. It tailors each letter to the applicant's profile and the specific job description, and delivers it in under two minutes.

challenges.title: Generic, low-impact letters
challenges.text: Copy-paste templates produced letters identical to hundreds of other applicants'.

challenges.title: Time-intensive writing
challenges.text: A tailored letter took 30 to 60 minutes per application.

challenges.title: No personalization at scale
challenges.text: Existing AI tools were not calibrated to the candidate, the job description or the industry's language.

challenges.title: Poor recruiter readability
challenges.text: Most AI letters lacked structure, tone and the keywords screening systems look for.

solutions.title: AI personalization engine
solutions.text: A pipeline combining candidate profile data with job description parsing to generate a unique letter per role.

solutions.title: Role-specific content
solutions.text: Logic that extracts requirements, skills and tone from the job description and mirrors them in the letter.

solutions.title: Formatting and tone control
solutions.text: Formal, conversational or industry-specific voice, with recruiter-ready output.

solutions.title: Fast, frictionless UX
solutions.text: A minimal interface that returns a complete letter in under two minutes.

results: Full AI cover letter platform live in production
100K+ cover letters generated by 10,000+ active users
Multi-tone support with role-specific personalization on every letter
architecture: A React front end and Node.js API run on PostgreSQL and AWS. The OpenAI API generates each letter, with prompts that control role, tone and format.
